label: live-demo
alert: Operation GET /api/products/index on frontend failing: error rate 14%; Operation POST /api/checkout on frontend failing: error rate 20%
summary: The product-catalog container restarted due to high memory usage reaching its 20MiB limit (99.1% memory utilization). During the container restart, requests from frontend and checkout to ProductCatalogService failed with ECONNREFUSED/ECONNRESET, causing 500 errors on GET /api/products/index and POST /api/checkout.
symptoms: Frontend GET /api/products/index and POST /api/checkout endpoints failed with HTTP 500 errors.
gRPC client calls to ProductCatalogService/GetProduct failed with 14 UNAVAILABLE read ECONNRESET and connection refused errors.
Checkout PlaceOrder requests failed with 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product'.

root_cause.description: The product-catalog service restarted due to memory pressure under its tight 20MiB memory limit (reaching 99.1% utilization). While product-catalog was restarting, downstream gRPC requests from frontend and checkout failed with ECONNREFUSED, ECONNRESET, and EOF errors, resulting in elevated error rates on GET /api/products/index and POST /api/checkout.

evidence.explanation: Container health check flagged product-catalog as having restart problems.
Product catalog container restarted with a total restart count of 9.
Recent container events confirm product-catalog restarted recently.
Product catalog memory usage reached 99.1% of its 20MB limit before dropping post-restart.
Frontend logs recorded connection refused errors trying to reach product-catalog port 3550 while product-catalog was restarting.
evidence.quote: "14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 172.22.0.17:3550."

evidence.explanation: Traces show gRPC ECONNRESET errors on frontend calls to product-catalog during the restart window.
Checkout calls to product-catalog failed with EOF while product-catalog restarted.
Checkout order preparation failed because product lookup on product-catalog failed.
evidence.quote: "failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"0PUK6V6EV0""

ruled_out: Payment service: Recently restarted in prior remediation but currently healthy with 0 errors.
Astronomy DB: PostgreSQL container running normally with low CPU and memory utilization.
Frontend application logic: Errors on frontend were purely upstream call failures due to product-catalog unavailability.

proposed_action.reason: product-catalog experienced a crash_loop/restart under memory pressure; restarting the service mitigates the immediate downtime/service availability issue per runbook
proposed_action.expected_outcome: product-catalog service restarts cleanly and restores gRPC availability for frontend and checkout requests

prevention: Increase the memory limit for the product-catalog container (e.g. from 20MiB to 50MiB) or investigate potential memory allocation issues in the product-catalog service.
